filesystem.description: Read/write project files, datasets, and experiment records.

github.description: Issues, PRs, branches, releases. Needs a PAT with repo scope, exported in your shell.

memory.description: Knowledge graph for research findings and entity relationships across sessions.

fetch.description: Fetch papers, docs, and dataset pages as markdown.

sqlite.description: Ad-hoc analysis over experiment results. Note: NOT the LightMem memory store - that is Qdrant.

jupyter.description: Drive LightMem/tutorial-notebooks - create, edit, execute cells, inspect outputs.

bgpt.description: Scientific paper search with full-text experimental data. 50 free searches, no key.

serena.description: LSP-backed symbol search and safe symbol-level edits (rename/move/inline) across Python. Install: uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent
